title: Learned / physics-based motion spike (#8, Tier-2 R&D)
summary: Forward/v2 research spike for AUTH #043 item #8 (learned/physics-based motion), opened and explored by the Builder now; GPU experiments run on the Operator's return. Three offline experiments, each with a go/no-go gate, none gating v1 (which ships classic motion matching, M1-MOVE-01): (A) Learned Motion Matching on the ~110-clip whitelist — DB compression + on-device per-frame cost vs the classic baseline; (B) offline neural augmentation of the traversal vocabulary on scanned-terrain variants, fed into the v1 clip DB (the sound form of 'video -> usable motion'); (C) physics-RL (AMP/ASE/PARC-style) feasibility on one traversal verb + a distillation verdict. All on Tier-2 compute; our own mocap + the consented corpus only (SPEC §3.3), never user scans.
deliverables: research/tier2/experiment-b-run-spec.md (Experiment B runbook — inputs, recipe, coverage metric)
services/traversal/motion_coverage.py + tests (the Experiment B coverage metric, Brain-B)
Experiment reports (A/B/C) under research/tier2/ when the GPU runs happen

acceptance_tests.test: A grounded landscape + mobile-feasibility exploration of learned motion matching, neural synthesis/diffusion, and physics-RL control, with a per-approach fit assessment and a three-experiment spike plan with go/no-go gates, is delivered.

Experiment A: Learned Motion Matching reproduced on the whitelist; DB size and transition quality vs the classic baseline, plus a Sentis/Core ML on-device per-frame cost on a reference iPhone, are measured against the 60 MB / 4 ms budget.
acceptance_tests.evidence: RunPod run log + report + on-device numbers

acceptance_tests.test: Experiment B: offline neural augmentation produces a measurable clip-coverage/quality gain on corpus rooms, within the DB budget and clean-IP (our mocap + CC0/licensed only), suitable to fold into the v1 DB.
acceptance_tests.evidence: augmented clip set + corpus coverage report

acceptance_tests.test: Experiment C: a physics-RL (PARC-style) feasibility prototype on one traversal verb with an adaptivity measurement and a credible runtime-distillation verdict (or a clear hardware-gated v2+ conclusion).

security: SPEC §3.3 (training on our own infra; no user scans — our mocap + consented corpus only)
blocked_by: Experiment B compute: one round is 'a few GPU-days' (spec §4) ≈ $36–71 on a Runpod Secure RTX 4090 (2–4 days) — inside AUTH #040's $500/mo but beyond the cash caps (Runpod prepaid $48.57 hard cap, auto-pay off; Modal $20/mo, $13.17 left in Oct). Needs an Owner Runpod top-up (≈ $75–100 per round) or a higher Modal limit.

Experiment B inputs: the ~110-clip seed DB (M1-MOVE-01, open; 0 FBX in repo), the Owner's Rokoko/Move.ai P0-verb captures, corpus traversal graphs (video reconstructions lack metric scale; M1-CAPT-01 / M1-SCEN-01..04), and a motion generator (none in repo).
Experiment A/C: the classic motion-matching baseline (M1-MOVE-01) and Tier-2 GPU (AUTH #040 / #039 funds).
